I'll build the Quellight landing page in stages: nav, hero, chat preview, features, CTA, and footer. Starting with the nav bar.

Hero applied. Now a dark chat-window preview to show the product in action.

Finally, the footer.

The Quellight landing page is built and confirmed in the editor (revision r1#8). It includes:

Nav bar — "Quellight" brand, Product/Pricing/Docs/Changelog links, "Get started" button

Hero — headline, subcopy, primary/secondary CTAs ("Start free", "See how it works") and a reassurance note

Chat preview — a dark product mock with a sample Kyoto-trip conversation and a decorative prompt bar with "Send"

Features — "Everything you need, in one chat" with three cards: Instant answers, Writes with you, Codes & debugs

CTA band — email input (labeled, type=email) + "Join the beta" button on a dark panel

Footer — separator, copyright and Privacy/Terms/Security/Contact links

Consistent styling: indigo accent (#6D5EF3), ink
